theg pa'i rim pa mngon du bshad pa'i mdo rgyud kyi 'grel pa
item.coloph: sprul sku gshen rab mi bo ngas/ yang rtse bla med rdzogs chen theg pa'i mdo/ ri yi rgyal po lha ri gyang tho'i rtser/ 'phrul bon lha rabs sgom gsum la sogs te/ 'khor gyi gshen rab rig can rnams la bshad/ mdo rgyud 'grel ba tshad ma'i rgyal po 'di/ mi 'khrul mi bslu sems kyi dkyil du chongs/ bon gyi bstan pa rgyas shing 'phel bar 'gyur/ theg pa rim pa bshad pa'i mdo rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ 'phrul gyi me long dgu skor zhes bya ba dge'o//
